mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the focusing lens was most worthwhile: the explanation connected its movement to forming a sharp image on the cloth.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to attach the lens before setting up the cloth was frustrating because the assembly gave no indication of what was missing.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the projection was upside down, even though the invented constellations still worked.

arbitrary.text: The cloth having to come before the lens felt a little arbitrary until inspecting the theatre revealed the blurry-image test.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the blurry blobs become a focused, turning sky made the construction and its optics worth exploring.
